Color & Font Dialogs
ColorDialog: • Color: Gets/sets the selected Color. • AllowFullOpen: Toggles custom color palette. • CustomColors: Array storing custom RGB values. FontDialog: • Font: Gets/sets the selected Font. • ShowColor: Enables color selection. • ShowEffects: Enables Underline, Strikeout, and Color. • MinSize / MaxSize: Limits allowable point sizes. Core Methods & Events: • ShowDialog(): Opens the dialog modally. • Reset(): Restores default properties. • Apply: Updates styles without closing the dialog. • HelpRequest: Triggers when the Help button is clicked.
